{{Top|leg}}
'''Disrupter generators''' were used to interfere with the structure of a [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]], allowing objects to pass through. [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] science labs used disrupter generators to allow mechanical arms to pass through the magnetic fields surrounding the cage that held a captured [[Polydroxol]].<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref>
